lines.text: Many learners say: The car of my father is old.
Better: My father's car is old.
My mom's! This is my mom's car.

data.wrong: The car of my father is old.

native.hook: “The car of my father”: suena raro
native.tip: Para el dueño usa “'s”: “my father's car”. “Of” casi no se usa con personas.
native.caption: En español “el coche de mi padre”, pero en inglés usamos 's 🚗 No “The car of my father is old.”, sino “My father's car is old.”. ¡Escucha a Ama y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “Ana's”. Dueño + 's + cosa. Practica más con un quiz gratis aquí: {link}

en.hook: “The car of my father” sounds odd
en.tip: For the owner use “'s”: “my father's car”. “Of” is rare with people.
en.caption: In Spanish “el coche de mi padre”, but English uses 's. Not “The car of my father is old.”, but “My father's car is old.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
